name: dispersion_scalar
scope: Shared Gaussian, normalization, switching, coordination, BJ/zero damping, D4 charge scaling, ATM edge/C6 responses, EEQ RHS/Coulomb-matrix primals, and cached Cartesian-norm radial pullbacks derived by automatic differentiation. Overflowed zero damping reconstructs energy and response independently in the log2 domain. Native traversal, contraction, bounded LU solves and scatter remain; no separate scheduler promotion is claimed.
